rows: Why is Guatemala the biggest cardamom producer?
German coffee planters introduced it ~1914; Highland Alta Verapaz microclimate is perfect; not a historical connection, just accidental geographic match
Why do Scandinavians use so much cardamom?
Viking trade via Constantinople brought it north ~9th century; 1,100-year-old flavor preference preserved through cultural transmission
What makes green cardamom's cooling sensation?
1,8-Cineole (eucalyptol) — same compound in eucalyptus. Cooling perception is from olfactory signaling, not actual temperature change.
Can I substitute black for green cardamom?
No. Black = smoky, camphor, earthy (savory biryani). Green = floral, cooling, sweet (chai, desserts). Completely different flavor roles.
Tamiflu synthesis required shikimic acid from Chinese star anise; 2005 H5N1 fear created global demand surge exposing single-source supply chain vulnerability
Why is star anise anethole if it's not Apiaceae?
Convergent evolution — independent evolution of same biosynthetic pathway (phenylalanine → anethole) in unrelated plant families
How do I identify toxic Japanese star anise?
More follicles (8–13, irregular), shriveled. Genuine star anise = 8 regular boat-shaped follicles. Ground star anise: cannot distinguish visually.
